title: Malaysia Airlines Business to Japan: Ex BNE $3363, ADL $3601, PER $3682, MEL $3689, SYD $3828 Return (Aug 26-Jul 27) @ BTF
body:
Deal: Malaysia Airlines Business to Japan: Ex BNE $3363, ADL $3601, PER $3682, MEL $3689, SYD $3828 Return (Aug 26-Jul 27) @ BTF

[macmanluke] 20hr+ layovers for all options i could see kind sucks unless you want to spend time in Malaysia
[DingoBilly] Yep. You pay $3000+ more than a Jetstar flight and fly for over twice as long.
I don't see the appeal at all.
[Losmano] You don't see the appeal of flying Malaysia Airlines over Jetstar?
[xt20] The flight from KUL to FUK is on a Boeing 737-8 MAX without any in-flight entertainment, while KUL to Narita and Osaka are on more comfortable wide body aircraft.
[melo4510] yes. i think the 737-8 MAX does not have a lie flat seat too. to keep in mind
[OhNoUShiz] https://www.channelnewsasia.com/shorts/malaysia-airlines-fli…
[nzthunderboy] Books into Z class which only credits as Premium economy with Qantas
[Drakesy] Just looked at business tickets return on POINTS to europe with emirates - $3200 in taxes and carrier charges
Points are a joke
[OnlyHans] Depends on the airline, with a couple known to be far worse than others - Emirates often topping the list.
However, it would be misleading to imply that all classic rewards come with such a high cost.
Some partner airlines actually charge very little such as American, Alaska and Fiji, while others fall between the two extremes.
(Not sure if you're referring to Qantas Points or Enrich Points, but either way I'm presuming the generalisation about carrier charges varying significantly across partner airlines remains broadly accurate.)
[Blokeinhisundies] Yes, Emirates are ridiculous and I never even look at redeeming via them. For comparison. I went to Europe a couple of years ago with Singapore airlines using Krisflyer points and taxes/carrier charges were about $250 in total.
I not long booked for May next year using velocity points and it was about $500 one way on SIA and a bit over $700 coming back on Qatar.
[Dream-cast] Recently relaunched Korea Airlines had economy tickets for around 1500 from Melbourne to Tokyo over Christmas. Kicking myself for not booking it. Also sucks my work forces leave over Christmas.
